triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Triage: lands in `area:ai` · `domain:skills` · `priority:p1` · Task · `pm:blocked` (`Blocked-by: #36721`); `area:build` → `area:ai`; suggested p2 → **p1**.
Rationale: once #36721 merges, `data-hooks.md` will still tell the AI that a regex pattern the checking engine refuses is only a warning, but the publish door will refuse it as an error. The skill would then teach a wrong rule, not merely leave one out. The table puts AI taught wrong at p1, the same grade as #36628. Skills cards sit in `area:ai` because their reader is the AI. The card unlocks when #36721 lands and should ship right behind it.

repo:objectstack#7 · os-alice · session_011y7As8yeqbR9TKANdPKRxt

2026-11-24T05:25Z · Area: o7-spec

Scope addition from PR #36721's rework round (contract record 7122903388, delta read 7122922830): the data-hooks.md sentence to write gains a third warning case. After #36721, a regex pattern the checking host refuses is a `warning` when it is a duplicate named capture group, a modifier group, **or a Unicode property name only the runtime (QuickJS) knows** (twelve measured spellings: `IDS_Unary_Operator`/`IDSU`, `Modifier_Combining_Mark`/`MCM`, `Katakana_Or_Hiragana`/`Hrkt` under `sc=`/`Script=`/`scx=`/`Script_Extensions=`; on a host whose Unicode tables are older than 17.0, every property-name refusal is a warning). Every other pattern failure is refused.
